prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1327; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving east on the main road in League City, heading toward the shopping center. It was a clear afternoon and the road was dry.

Q: What happened just before the impact?

A: A sedan coming the other way drifted over the center line. I braked and steered right, but it still clipped the front of my car. We were going maybe fifteen miles an hour, so it wasn't a hard hit.

Q: Did either airbag deploy?

A: No. Both cars were still drivable, and we pulled onto the shoulder.

Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that evening. My lower back was sore and stiff, and the doctor diagnosed a back strain.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any pain or limitations?

A: Yes. Sitting for long periods bothers me, and I've been doing gentle stretching as the doctor suggested. I missed a few days of work while I recovered.

Q: Had you experienced any prior problems with your lower back?

A: Not that I can recall. I'd never had anything serious.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm glad nobody was seriously hurt.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
